notes: Published as decider-2b-vision_fp16-int8vocab.litertlm (the lane's name decider-2b-vision_v7c.litertlm; content unchanged) in litert-community/decider-2b-vision-LiteRT (Hub commit 6c024e94, 2026-09-29): the Hub LFS sha256 equals the measured file's (72f68360..., 4,498,201,472 B). The reference readout that ships in the model repo (reference/decider_litert.py) reads the bundle's TFLite sections itself (no litert-lm) and runs them with ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 CompiledModel on the CPU (8 threads), vision encoder + adapter, then the decoder prefilled with exact-fit signatures up to each answer slot and one decode, softmax over the option letters at T = 1: this is the path that returns option probabilities. One process per run under /usr/bin/time -l on the published row game_pong_atari_up (150 prompt tokens, one question), its section folder and XNNPACK weight cache already on disk; three uncontended processes (litertlm-convert decider2bv_work round 6, scripts/r6_ref_bench_row.py, 2026-09-29 02:15-02:43 JST).
quantization: decoder fully connected weights fp16, output head dynamic int8, token embedding int8 (channelwise); vision encoder and adapter fp16; fp32 activation preference declared on the decoder section
